description: This file defines the PostAuthOptionProvider class which provides options for access tokens within the oauth2-client library. It implements methods to generate request options and request body for obtaining access tokens, specifically for POST requests.

classes.name: PostAuthOptionProvider
classes.description: A class providing options related to access token requests, including generating headers and request body for token acquisition.

methods.name: getAccessTokenOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of options for the access token request, including headers and body if method is POST.

methods.name: getAccessTokenBody
methods.description: Builds and returns the request body string for obtaining an access token from parameters.
